response.text:
30-minute Product Review — Agenda (brainstorming only; do not add to calendar)

Duration: 30 minutes
Purpose: Quick status check to align on metrics, surface risks, and make any required decisions.

0:00–0:05 — Welcome & Objectives
- Host: [name]
- Confirm meeting objective and desired outcomes (e.g., agree next steps, assign owners)
- Quick roll call / confirm timebox

0:05–0:17 — Metrics (12 min)
- Top KPIs since last review (traffic, conversion, retention, revenue — highlight deltas vs target)
- Short explanation of major changes or trends (what moved and suspected causes)
- Any data anomalies or measurement concerns needing follow-up

0:17–0:25 — Risks & Blockers (8 min)
- Key risks (technical reliability, customer experience, regulatory/compliance, market/competitive)
- For each risk: current impact, probability estimate, immediate mitigation options
- Identify blockers that would prevent planned milestones

0:25–0:30 — Decisions & Next Steps (5 min)
- List decisions required now (go/no-go, reprioritization, resource shifts) with brief options
- Assign owners and deadlines for each decision/action
- Confirm artifacts to produce (notes, updated dashboard, risk log) and next check-in cadence

Preparation / Pre-reads (to share ~24 hours before)
- Latest KPI dashboard with short summary (one page or slides)
- Recent incidents/bugs and status
- Customer feedback highlights or support trends
- Proposed decision options (if decisions are expected)

Desired outcomes
- Shared understanding of current performance and risks
- Clear decisions or agreements on next actions, with owners and deadlines
- List of follow-up items and owner for deeper investigations

If you want, I can tailor this agenda to a specific product area or list suggested attendees.
